answer.text: Only by converting NRE to resident

explanation.text: **The Logic:** NRIs can invest in PMS subject to RBI/FEMA/PIS guidelines. **The Trap:** NRIs need not convert residency; PMS is not restricted to Cat I AIFs. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same framework in X-B. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Route NRI subscriptions via NRE/NRO and follow PIS rules carefully.
